[212](#212)#[proc_macro_attribute]
[213](#213)pub fn safety_case(args: TokenStream, input: TokenStream) -> TokenStream {
[214](#214)    let case_id = parse_macro_input!(args as LitStr).value();
[215](#215)    if let Err(err) = validate_case_id(&case_id) {
[216](#216)        return err.to_compile_error().into();
[217](#217)    }
[218](#218)
[219](#219)    let function = parse_macro_input!(input as ItemFn);
[220](#220)    let checks = match collect_safety_checks(&case_id, &function.block) {
[221](#221)        Ok(checks) => checks,
[222](#222)        Err(err) => return err.to_compile_error().into(),
[223](#223)    };
[224](#224)
[225](#225)    if checks.is_empty() {
[226](#226)        return syn::Error::new_spanned(
[227](#227)            &function.sig.ident,
[228](#228)            format!("safety case '{case_id}' must contain at least one safety_check! or safety_check_eq!"),
[229](#229)        )
[230](#230)        .to_compile_error()
[231](#231)        .into();
[232](#232)    }
[233](#233)
[234](#234)    let function_ident = &function.sig.ident;
[235](#235)    let checks_tokens = checks.iter().map(|check| {
[236](#236)        let check_id = &check.check_id;
[237](#237)        let requirement_id = &check.requirement_id;
[238](#238)        let kind = check.kind;
[239](#239)        quote! {
[240](#240)            ::cu29::safety::SafetyCheckRef {
[241](#241)                check_id: #check_id,
[242](#242)                requirement_id: #requirement_id,
[243](#243)                kind: #kind,
[244](#244)            }
[245](#245)        }
[246](#246)    });
[247](#247)
[248](#248)    quote! {
[249](#249)        #function
[250](#250)
[251](#251)        #[cfg(feature = "safety-ids")]
[252](#252)        ::cu29::safety::inventory::submit! {
[253](#253)            ::cu29::safety::SafetyCaseRef {
[254](#254)                package: env!("CARGO_PKG_NAME"),
[255](#255)                case_id: #case_id,
[256](#256)                function: stringify!(#function_ident),
[257](#257)                module_path: module_path!(),
[258](#258)                file: file!(),
[259](#259)                checks: &[#(#checks_tokens),*],
[260](#260)            }
[261](#261)        }
[262](#262)    }
[263](#263)    .into()
[264](#264)}
[265](#265)
[266](#266)fn collect_safety_checks(
[267](#267)    case_id: &str,
[268](#268)    block: &Block,
[269](#269)) -> Result<Vec<ParsedSafetyCheck>, syn::Error> {
[270](#270)    let mut checks = Vec::new();
[271](#271)    collect_safety_checks_from_block(block, &mut checks)?;
[272](#272)
[273](#273)    let mut ids = BTreeSet::new();
[274](#274)    for check in &checks {
[275](#275)        validate_check_id(case_id, &check.check_id)?;
[276](#276)        validate_requirement_id(&check.requirement_id)?;
[277](#277)        if !ids.insert(check.check_id.clone()) {
[278](#278)            return Err(syn::Error::new(
[279](#279)                Span::call_site(),
[280](#280)                format!("duplicate safety check ID '{}'", check.check_id),
[281](#281)            ));
[282](#282)        }
[283](#283)    }
[284](#284)
[285](#285)    Ok(checks)
[286](#286)}
[287](#287)
[288](#288)fn collect_safety_checks_from_block(
[289](#289)    block: &Block,
[290](#290)    checks: &mut Vec<ParsedSafetyCheck>,
[291](#291)) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[292](#292)    for stmt in &block.stmts {
[293](#293)        collect_safety_checks_from_stmt(stmt, checks)?;
[294](#294)    }
[295](#295)    Ok(())
[296](#296)}
[297](#297)
[298](#298)fn collect_safety_checks_from_stmt(
[299](#299)    stmt: &Stmt,
[300](#300)    checks: &mut Vec<ParsedSafetyCheck>,
[301](#301)) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[302](#302)    match stmt {
[303](#303)        Stmt::Local(local) => {
[304](#304)            if let Some(init) = &local.init {
[305](#305)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&init.expr, checks)?;
[306](#306)                if let Some((_else, expr)) = &init.diverge {
[307](#307)                    collect_safety_checks_from_expr(expr, checks)?;
[308](#308)                }
[309](#309)            }
[310](#310)        }
[311](#311)        Stmt::Item(_) => {}
[312](#312)        Stmt::Expr(expr, _) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(expr, checks)?,
[313](#313)        Stmt::Macro(stmt_macro) => {
[314](#314)            if let Some(check) = parse_safety_check_macro(&stmt_macro.mac)? {
[315](#315)                checks.push(check);
[316](#316)            }
[317](#317)        }
[318](#318)    }
[319](#319)    Ok(())
[320](#320)}
[321](#321)
[322](#322)fn collect_safety_checks_from_expr(
[323](#323)    expr: &Expr,
[324](#324)    checks: &mut Vec<ParsedSafetyCheck>,
[325](#325)) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[326](#326)    match expr {
[327](#327)        Expr::Array(expr) => {
[328](#328)            for elem in &expr.elems {
[329](#329)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(elem, checks)?;
[330](#330)            }
[331](#331)        }
[332](#332)        Expr::Assign(expr) => {
[333](#333)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.left, checks)?;
[334](#334)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.right, checks)?;
[335](#335)        }
[336](#336)        Expr::Async(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.block, checks)?,
[337](#337)        Expr::Await(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.base, checks)?,
[338](#338)        Expr::Binary(expr) => {
[339](#339)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.left, checks)?;
[340](#340)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.right, checks)?;
[341](#341)        }
[342](#342)        Expr::Block(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.block, checks)?,
[343](#343)        Expr::Break(expr) => {
[344](#344)            if let Some(value) = &expr.expr {
[345](#345)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(value, checks)?;
[346](#346)            }
[347](#347)        }
[348](#348)        Expr::Call(expr) => {
[349](#349)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.func, checks)?;
[350](#350)            for arg in &expr.args {
[351](#351)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(arg, checks)?;
[352](#352)            }
[353](#353)        }
[354](#354)        Expr::Cast(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[355](#355)        Expr::Closure(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.body, checks)?,
[356](#356)        Expr::Field(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.base, checks)?,
[357](#357)        Expr::ForLoop(expr) => {
[358](#358)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?;
[359](#359)            collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.body, checks)?;
[360](#360)        }
[361](#361)        Expr::Group(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[362](#362)        Expr::If(expr) => {
[363](#363)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.cond, checks)?;
[364](#364)            collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.then_branch, checks)?;
[365](#365)            if let Some((_else, else_expr)) = &expr.else_branch {
[366](#366)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(else_expr, checks)?;
[367](#367)            }
[368](#368)        }
[369](#369)        Expr::Index(expr) => {
[370](#370)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?;
[371](#371)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.index, checks)?;
[372](#372)        }
[373](#373)        Expr::Let(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[374](#374)        Expr::Loop(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.body, checks)?,
[375](#375)        Expr::Macro(expr_macro) => {
[376](#376)            if let Some(check) = parse_safety_check_macro(&expr_macro.mac)? {
[377](#377)                checks.push(check);
[378](#378)            }
[379](#379)        }
[380](#380)        Expr::Match(expr) => {
[381](#381)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?;
[382](#382)            for arm in &expr.arms {
[383](#383)                if let Some((_, guard)) = &arm.guard {
[384](#384)                    collect_safety_checks_from_expr(guard, checks)?;
[385](#385)                }
[386](#386)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&arm.body, checks)?;
[387](#387)            }
[388](#388)        }
[389](#389)        Expr::MethodCall(expr) => {
[390](#390)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.receiver, checks)?;
[391](#391)            for arg in &expr.args {
[392](#392)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(arg, checks)?;
[393](#393)            }
[394](#394)        }
[395](#395)        Expr::Paren(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[396](#396)        Expr::Reference(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[397](#397)        Expr::Repeat(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[398](#398)        Expr::Return(expr) => {
[399](#399)            if let Some(value) = &expr.expr {
[400](#400)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(value, checks)?;
[401](#401)            }
[402](#402)        }
[403](#403)        Expr::Struct(expr) => {
[404](#404)            for field in &expr.fields {
[405](#405)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&field.expr, checks)?;
[406](#406)            }
[407](#407)            if let Some(rest) = &expr.rest {
[408](#408)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(rest, checks)?;
[409](#409)            }
[410](#410)        }
[411](#411)        Expr::Try(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[412](#412)        Expr::TryBlock(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.block, checks)?,
[413](#413)        Expr::Tuple(expr) => {
[414](#414)            for elem in &expr.elems {
[415](#415)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(elem, checks)?;
[416](#416)            }
[417](#417)        }
[418](#418)        Expr::Unary(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.expr, checks)?,
[419](#419)        Expr::Unsafe(expr) => collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.block, checks)?,
[420](#420)        Expr::While(expr) => {
[421](#421)            collect_safety_checks_from_expr(&expr.cond, checks)?;
[422](#422)            collect_safety_checks_from_block(&expr.body, checks)?;
[423](#423)        }
[424](#424)        Expr::Yield(expr) => {
[425](#425)            if let Some(value) = &expr.expr {
[426](#426)                collect_safety_checks_from_expr(value, checks)?;
[427](#427)            }
[428](#428)        }
[429](#429)        _ => {}
[430](#430)    }
[431](#431)    Ok(())
[432](#432)}
[433](#433)
[434](#434)fn parse_safety_check_macro(mac: &syn::Macro) -> Result<Option<ParsedSafetyCheck>, syn::Error> {
[435](#435)    let Some(segment) = mac.path.segments.last() else {
[436](#436)        return Ok(None);
[437](#437)    };
[438](#438)
[439](#439)    let kind = match segment.ident.to_string().as_str() {
[440](#440)        "safety_check" => "assert",
[441](#441)        "safety_check_eq" => "assert_eq",
[442](#442)        _ => return Ok(None),
[443](#443)    };
[444](#444)
[445](#445)    let args = Punctuated::<Expr, Token![,]>::parse_terminated.parse2(mac.tokens.clone())?;
[446](#446)    let min_args = if kind == "assert_eq" { 4 } else { 3 };
[447](#447)    if args.len() < min_args {
[448](#448)        return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(
[449](#449)            mac,
[450](#450)            format!(
[451](#451)                "{}! expects at least {} arguments: check ID, requirement ID, and assertion inputs",
[452](#452)                segment.ident, min_args
[453](#453)            ),
[454](#454)        ));
[455](#455)    }
[456](#456)
[457](#457)    let check_id = string_literal_from_expr(&args[0], "safety check ID")?;
[458](#458)    let requirement_id = string_literal_from_expr(&args[1], "requirement ID")?;
[459](#459)
[460](#460)    Ok(Some(ParsedSafetyCheck {
[461](#461)        check_id,
[462](#462)        requirement_id,
[463](#463)        kind,
[464](#464)    }))
[465](#465)}

[467](#467)fn string_literal_from_expr(expr: &Expr, label: &str) -> Result<String, syn::Error> {
[468](#468)    let Expr::Lit(expr_lit) = expr else {

[470](#470)            expr,
[471](#471)            format!("{label} must be a string literal"),
[472](#472)        ));
[473](#473)    };
[474](#474)    let Lit::Str(value) = &expr_lit.lit else {
[475](#475)        return Err(syn::Error::new_spanned(
[476](#476)            expr,
[477](#477)            format!("{label} must be a string literal"),
[478](#478)        ));
[479](#479)    };
[480](#480)    Ok(value.value())

[487](#487)fn validate_check_id(case_id: &str, check_id: &str) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[488](#488)    validate_id(check_id, "TEST", true)?;
[489](#489)    if !check_id.starts_with(case_id) {
[490](#490)        return Err(syn::Error::new(
[491](#491)            Span::call_site(),
[492](#492)            format!("safety check ID '{check_id}' must start with case ID '{case_id}'"),

[498](#498)fn validate_requirement_id(requirement_id: &str) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {

[501](#501)
[502](#502)fn validate_id(value: &str, kind: &str, allow_check_suffix: bool) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[503](#503)    let mut parts = value.split('-');
[504](#504)    let Some(prefix) = parts.next() else {
[505](#505)        return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[506](#506)    };
[507](#507)    let Some(actual_kind) = parts.next() else {
[508](#508)        return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[509](#509)    };
[510](#510)    let Some(number) = parts.next() else {
[511](#511)        return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[512](#512)    };
[513](#513)
[514](#514)    if !prefix.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase())
[515](#515)        || actual_kind != kind
[516](#516)        || number.len() != 3
[517](#517)        || !number.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit())
[518](#518)    {
[519](#519)        return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[520](#520)    }
[521](#521)
[522](#522)    match parts.next() {
[523](#523)        None => Ok(()),
[524](#524)        Some(check_suffix) if allow_check_suffix && check_suffix.starts_with('C') => {
[525](#525)            let digits = &check_suffix[1..];
[526](#526)            if digits.is_empty() || !digits.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
[527](#527)                return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[528](#528)            }
[529](#529)            if parts.next().is_some() {
[530](#530)                return invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix);
[531](#531)            }
[532](#532)            Ok(())
[533](#533)        }
[534](#534)        _ => invalid_id(value, kind, allow_check_suffix),
[535](#535)    }
[536](#536)}
[537](#537)
[538](#538)fn invalid_id(value: &str, kind: &str, allow_check_suffix: bool) -> Result<(), syn::Error> {
[539](#539)    let suffix = if allow_check_suffix {
[540](#540)        " or PREFIX-TEST-001-C1"
[541](#541)    } else {
[542](#542)        ""
[543](#543)    };
[544](#544)    Err(syn::Error::new(
[545](#545)        Span::call_site(),
[546](#546)        format!("invalid ID '{value}', expected PREFIX-{kind}-001{suffix}"),
[547](#547)    ))
[548](#548)}

[5720](#5720)
[5721](#5721)fn resolve_runtime_config_with_root(
[5722](#5722)    args: &CopperRuntimeArgs,
[5723](#5723)    caller_root: &Path,
[5724](#5724)) -> CuResult<ResolvedRuntimeConfig> {
[5725](#5725)    let filename = config_full_path_from_root(caller_root, &args.config_path);
[5726](#5726)    if !Path::new(&filename).exists() {
[5727](#5727)        return Err(CuError::from(format!(
[5728](#5728)            "The configuration file `{}` does not exist. Please provide a valid path.",
[5729](#5729)            args.config_path
[5730](#5730)        )));
[5731](#5731)    }
[5732](#5732)
[5733](#5733)    if let Some(subsystem_id) = args.subsystem_id.as_deref() {
[5734](#5734)        let multi_config = cu29_runtime::config::read_multi_configuration(filename.as_str())
[5735](#5735)            .map_err(|e| {
[5736](#5736)                CuError::from(format!(
[5737](#5737)                    "When `subsystem = \"{subsystem_id}\"` is provided, `config = \"{}\"` must point to a valid multi-Copper configuration: {e}",
[5738](#5738)                    args.config_path
[5739](#5739)                ))
[5740](#5740)            })?;
[5741](#5741)        let subsystem = multi_config.subsystem(subsystem_id).ok_or_else(|| {
[5742](#5742)            CuError::from(format!(
[5743](#5743)                "Subsystem '{subsystem_id}' was not found in multi-Copper configuration '{}'.",
[5744](#5744)                args.config_path
[5745](#5745)            ))
[5746](#5746)        })?;
[5747](#5747)        let bundled_local_config_content = read_to_string(&subsystem.config_path).map_err(|e| {
[5748](#5748)            CuError::from(format!(
[5749](#5749)                "Failed to read bundled local configuration for subsystem '{subsystem_id}' from '{}'.",
[5750](#5750)                subsystem.config_path
[5751](#5751)            ))
[5752](#5752)            .add_cause(e.to_string().as_str())
[5753](#5753)        })?;
[5754](#5754)
[5755](#5755)        Ok(ResolvedRuntimeConfig {
[5756](#5756)            local_config: subsystem.config.clone(),
[5757](#5757)            bundled_local_config_content,
[5758](#5758)            subsystem_id: Some(subsystem_id.to_string()),
[5759](#5759)            subsystem_code: subsystem.subsystem_code,
[5760](#5760)        })
[5761](#5761)    } else {
[5762](#5762)        Ok(ResolvedRuntimeConfig {
[5763](#5763)            local_config: read_configuration(filename.as_str())?,
[5764](#5764)            bundled_local_config_content: read_to_string(&filename).map_err(|e| {
[5765](#5765)                CuError::from(format!(
[5766](#5766)                    "Could not read the configuration file '{}'.",
[5767](#5767)                    args.config_path
[5768](#5768)                ))
[5769](#5769)                .add_cause(e.to_string().as_str())
[5770](#5770)            })?,
[5771](#5771)            subsystem_id: None,
[5772](#5772)            subsystem_code: 0,
[5773](#5773)        })
[5774](#5774)    }

[5777](#5777)fn build_config_load_stmt(

[5800](#5800)                        RuntimeLifecycleConfigSource::ExternalFile,

[5803](#5803)                    let original_config = Self::original_config();

[5805](#5805)                        "CuConfig: Using the bundled subsystem configuration compiled into the binary (subsystem={}).",
[5806](#5806)                        #subsystem_id

[5814](#5814)                    }

[5817](#5817)                        RuntimeLifecycleConfigSource::BundledDefault,
[5818](#5818)                    )
[5819](#5819)                };
[5820](#5820)            }
[5821](#5821)        } else {
[5822](#5822)            quote! {
[5823](#5823)                let _ = instance_id;
[5824](#5824)                let (config, config_source) = if let Some(overridden_config) = config_override {
[5825](#5825)                    debug!("CuConfig: Overridden programmatically.");
[5826](#5826)                    (overridden_config, RuntimeLifecycleConfigSource::ProgrammaticOverride)

[6234](#6234)
[6235](#6235)fn build_flat_slot_codec_bindings(
[6236](#6236)    cuconfig: &CuConfig,
[6237](#6237)    mission_label: Option<&str>,
[6238](#6238)    output_packs: &[OutputPack],
[6239](#6239)    node_output_positions: &HashMap<NodeId, usize>,
[6240](#6240)    task_names: &[(NodeId, String, String)],
[6241](#6241)) -> CuResult<Vec<Option<SlotCodecBinding>>> {
[6242](#6242)    let mut slot_task_ids: Vec<Option<String>> = vec![None; output_packs.len()];
[6243](#6243)    for (node_id, task_id, _) in task_names {
[6244](#6244)        let Some(output_position) = node_output_positions.get(node_id) else {
[6245](#6245)            continue;
[6246](#6246)        };
[6247](#6247)        slot_task_ids[*output_position] = Some(task_id.clone());
[6248](#6248)    }
[6249](#6249)
[6250](#6250)    let mut bindings =
[6251](#6251)        Vec::with_capacity(output_packs.iter().map(|pack| pack.msg_types.len()).sum());
[6252](#6252)    for (slot_idx, pack) in output_packs.iter().enumerate() {
[6253](#6253)        let task_id = slot_task_ids.get(slot_idx).and_then(|id| id.as_ref());
[6254](#6254)        for (port_idx, payload_type) in pack.msg_types.iter().enumerate() {
[6255](#6255)            let Some(task_id) = task_id else {
[6256](#6256)                bindings.push(None);
[6257](#6257)                continue;
[6258](#6258)            };
[6259](#6259)            let Some(msg_type) = pack.msg_type_names.get(port_idx) else {
[6260](#6260)                return Err(CuError::from(format!(
[6261](#6261)                    "Missing message type name for task '{task_id}' slot {slot_idx} port {port_idx}."
[6262](#6262)                )));
[6263](#6263)            };
[6264](#6264)
[6265](#6265)            let spec = cuconfig
[6266](#6266)                .find_task_node(mission_label, task_id)
[6267](#6267)                .and_then(|node| node.get_logging())
[6268](#6268)                .and_then(|logging| logging.codec_for_msg_type(msg_type))
[6269](#6269)                .map(|codec_id| {
[6270](#6270)                    cuconfig.find_logging_codec_spec(codec_id).ok_or_else(|| {
[6271](#6271)                        CuError::from(format!(
[6272](#6272)                            "Task '{task_id}' binds output '{msg_type}' to unknown logging codec '{codec_id}'."
[6273](#6273)                        ))
[6274](#6274)                    })
[6275](#6275)                })
[6276](#6276)                .transpose()?;
[6277](#6277)

[6525](#6525)const INPUT_MATCH_SCORE: i32 = 100;
[6526](#6526)const ANCHORED_INPUT_MATCH_BONUS: i32 = 1;
[6527](#6527)
[6528](#6528)fn task_input_match_score(slot: &CanonicalTaskInputSlot, input: &MissionTaskInput) -> Option<i32> {
[6529](#6529)    if slot.msg_type != input.msg_type {
[6530](#6530)        return None;
[6531](#6531)    }
[6532](#6532)
[6533](#6533)    let anchored_bonus = if slot.connection_orders.contains(&input.connection_order) {
[6534](#6534)        ANCHORED_INPUT_MATCH_BONUS
[6535](#6535)    } else {
[6536](#6536)        0
[6537](#6537)    };
[6538](#6538)
[6539](#6539)    Some(INPUT_MATCH_SCORE + anchored_bonus)

[6541](#6541)
[6542](#6542)fn update_alignment_cell(
[6543](#6543)    cell: &mut AlignmentCell,
[6544](#6544)    candidate_score: i32,
[6545](#6545)    candidate_paths: u8,
[6546](#6546)    backpointer: Option<AlignmentBackpointer>,
[6547](#6547)) {
[6548](#6548)    if candidate_paths == 0 {
[6549](#6549)        return;
[6550](#6550)    }
[6551](#6551)
[6552](#6552)    if candidate_score > cell.score {
[6553](#6553)        cell.score = candidate_score;
[6554](#6554)        cell.paths = candidate_paths.min(2);
[6555](#6555)        cell.backpointer = if candidate_paths == 1 {
[6556](#6556)            backpointer
[6557](#6557)        } else {
[6558](#6558)            None
[6559](#6559)        };
[6560](#6560)    } else if candidate_score == cell.score {
[6561](#6561)        cell.paths = cell.paths.saturating_add(candidate_paths).min(2);
[6562](#6562)        cell.backpointer = None;
[6563](#6563)    }

[6566](#6566)fn align_task_inputs(
[6567](#6567)    task_id: &str,
[6568](#6568)    mission_name: &str,
[6569](#6569)    canonical_slots: &[CanonicalTaskInputSlot],
[6570](#6570)    mission_inputs: &[MissionTaskInput],
[6571](#6571)) -> CuResult<Vec<AlignmentStep>> {
[6572](#6572)    let canonical_len = canonical_slots.len();
[6573](#6573)    let mission_len = mission_inputs.len();
[6574](#6574)    let mut table = vec![vec![AlignmentCell::unreachable(); mission_len + 1]; canonical_len + 1];
[6575](#6575)    table[0][0] = AlignmentCell {
[6576](#6576)        score: 0,
[6577](#6577)        paths: 1,
[6578](#6578)        backpointer: None,
[6579](#6579)    };
[6580](#6580)
[6581](#6581)    for i in 0..=canonical_len {
[6582](#6582)        for j in 0..=mission_len {
[6583](#6583)            let cell = table[i][j];
[6584](#6584)            if cell.paths == 0 {
[6585](#6585)                continue;
[6586](#6586)            }
[6587](#6587)
[6588](#6588)            if i < canonical_len {
[6589](#6589)                update_alignment_cell(
[6590](#6590)                    &mut table[i + 1][j],
[6591](#6591)                    cell.score,
[6592](#6592)                    cell.paths,
[6593](#6593)                    if cell.paths == 1 {
[6594](#6594)                        Some(AlignmentBackpointer {
[6595](#6595)                            prev_i: i,
[6596](#6596)                            prev_j: j,
[6597](#6597)                            transition: AlignmentTransition::ExistingGap,
[6598](#6598)                        })
[6599](#6599)                    } else {
[6600](#6600)                        None
[6601](#6601)                    },
[6602](#6602)                );
[6603](#6603)            }
[6604](#6604)
[6605](#6605)            if j < mission_len {
[6606](#6606)                update_alignment_cell(
[6607](#6607)                    &mut table[i][j + 1],
[6608](#6608)                    cell.score,
[6609](#6609)                    cell.paths,
[6610](#6610)                    if cell.paths == 1 {
[6611](#6611)                        Some(AlignmentBackpointer {
[6612](#6612)                            prev_i: i,
[6613](#6613)                            prev_j: j,
[6614](#6614)                            transition: AlignmentTransition::Insert,
[6615](#6615)                        })
[6616](#6616)                    } else {
[6617](#6617)                        None
[6618](#6618)                    },
[6619](#6619)                );
[6620](#6620)            }
[6621](#6621)
[6622](#6622)            if i < canonical_len
[6623](#6623)                && j < mission_len
[6624](#6624)                && let Some(match_score) =
[6625](#6625)                    task_input_match_score(&canonical_slots[i], &mission_inputs[j])
[6626](#6626)            {
[6627](#6627)                update_alignment_cell(
[6628](#6628)                    &mut table[i + 1][j + 1],
[6629](#6629)                    cell.score + match_score,
[6630](#6630)                    cell.paths,
[6631](#6631)                    if cell.paths == 1 {
[6632](#6632)                        Some(AlignmentBackpointer {
[6633](#6633)                            prev_i: i,
[6634](#6634)                            prev_j: j,
[6635](#6635)                            transition: AlignmentTransition::Match,
[6636](#6636)                        })
[6637](#6637)                    } else {
[6638](#6638)                        None
[6639](#6639)                    },
[6640](#6640)                );
[6641](#6641)            }
[6642](#6642)        }
[6643](#6643)    }
[6644](#6644)
[6645](#6645)    let final_cell = table[canonical_len][mission_len];
[6646](#6646)    if final_cell.paths > 1 {
[6647](#6647)        return Err(CuError::from(format!(
[6648](#6648)            "Task '{task_id}' has ambiguous input alignment while merging mission '{mission_name}'. Existing canonical inputs {} and mission inputs {} admit multiple equally valid alignments.",
[6649](#6649)            format_canonical_input_slots(canonical_slots),
[6650](#6650)            format_mission_task_inputs(mission_inputs),
[6651](#6651)        )));
[6652](#6652)    }
[6653](#6653)
[6654](#6654)    let mut steps = Vec::new();
[6655](#6655)    let (mut i, mut j) = (canonical_len, mission_len);
[6656](#6656)    while i > 0 || j > 0 {
[6657](#6657)        let backpointer = table[i][j].backpointer.unwrap_or_else(|| {
[6658](#6658)            panic!(
[6659](#6659)                "Missing backpointer while aligning task '{task_id}' for mission '{mission_name}'"
[6660](#6660)            )
[6661](#6661)        });
[6662](#6662)
[6663](#6663)        match backpointer.transition {
[6664](#6664)            AlignmentTransition::Match => steps.push(AlignmentStep::Match {
[6665](#6665)                canonical_slot_index: i - 1,
[6666](#6666)                mission_input_index: j - 1,
[6667](#6667)            }),
[6668](#6668)            AlignmentTransition::ExistingGap => steps.push(AlignmentStep::ExistingGap {
[6669](#6669)                canonical_slot_index: i - 1,
[6670](#6670)            }),
[6671](#6671)            AlignmentTransition::Insert => steps.push(AlignmentStep::Insert {
[6672](#6672)                mission_input_index: j - 1,
[6673](#6673)            }),
[6674](#6674)        }
[6675](#6675)
[6676](#6676)        i = backpointer.prev_i;
[6677](#6677)        j = backpointer.prev_j;
[6678](#6678)    }
[6679](#6679)    steps.reverse();
[6680](#6680)    Ok(steps)
[6681](#6681)}

[6683](#6683)fn merge_task_input_layout(
[6684](#6684)    task_id: &str,
[6685](#6685)    layout: &mut TaskInputLayout,
[6686](#6686)    mission_name: String,
[6687](#6687)    mission_inputs: Vec<MissionTaskInput>,
[6688](#6688)) -> CuResult<()> {
[6689](#6689)    let alignment = align_task_inputs(task_id, &mission_name, &layout.slots, &mission_inputs)?;
[6690](#6690)    let mut new_slots = Vec::with_capacity(alignment.len());
[6691](#6691)    let mut old_to_new = vec![None; layout.slots.len()];
[6692](#6692)    let mut mission_mapping = Vec::with_capacity(alignment.len());
[6693](#6693)
[6694](#6694)    for step in alignment {
[6695](#6695)        match step {
[6696](#6696)            AlignmentStep::Match {
[6697](#6697)                canonical_slot_index,
[6698](#6698)                mission_input_index,
[6699](#6699)            } => {
[6700](#6700)                let mut slot = layout.slots[canonical_slot_index].clone();
[6701](#6701)                slot.connection_orders
[6702](#6702)                    .insert(mission_inputs[mission_input_index].connection_order);
[6703](#6703)                let new_index = new_slots.len();
[6704](#6704)                old_to_new[canonical_slot_index] = Some(new_index);
[6705](#6705)                new_slots.push(slot);
[6706](#6706)                mission_mapping.push(Some(mission_input_index));
[6707](#6707)            }
[6708](#6708)            AlignmentStep::ExistingGap {
[6709](#6709)                canonical_slot_index,
[6710](#6710)            } => {
[6711](#6711)                let new_index = new_slots.len();
[6712](#6712)                old_to_new[canonical_slot_index] = Some(new_index);
[6713](#6713)                new_slots.push(layout.slots[canonical_slot_index].clone());
[6714](#6714)                mission_mapping.push(None);
[6715](#6715)            }
[6716](#6716)            AlignmentStep::Insert {
[6717](#6717)                mission_input_index,
[6718](#6718)            } => {
[6719](#6719)                new_slots.push(CanonicalTaskInputSlot {
[6720](#6720)                    msg_type: mission_inputs[mission_input_index].msg_type.clone(),
[6721](#6721)                    connection_orders: BTreeSet::from([
[6722](#6722)                        mission_inputs[mission_input_index].connection_order
[6723](#6723)                    ]),
[6724](#6724)                });
[6725](#6725)                mission_mapping.push(Some(mission_input_index));
[6726](#6726)            }
[6727](#6727)        }
[6728](#6728)    }
[6729](#6729)
[6730](#6730)    let mut remapped_mission_slot_mappings =
[6731](#6731)        HashMap::with_capacity(layout.mission_slot_mappings.len() + 1);
[6732](#6732)    for (existing_mission, existing_mapping) in &layout.mission_slot_mappings {
[6733](#6733)        let mut remapped = vec![None; new_slots.len()];
[6734](#6734)        for (old_slot_index, maybe_local_input_index) in existing_mapping.iter().enumerate() {
[6735](#6735)            let new_slot_index = old_to_new[old_slot_index].unwrap_or_else(|| {
[6736](#6736)                panic!("Missing remap for task '{task_id}' canonical slot {old_slot_index}")
[6737](#6737)            });
[6738](#6738)            remapped[new_slot_index] = *maybe_local_input_index;
[6739](#6739)        }
[6740](#6740)        remapped_mission_slot_mappings.insert(existing_mission.clone(), remapped);
[6741](#6741)    }
[6742](#6742)    remapped_mission_slot_mappings.insert(mission_name, mission_mapping);

[6749](#6749)fn collect_task_input_layouts(
[6750](#6750)    all_missions: &[(String, CuGraph)],
[6751](#6751)) -> CuResult<HashMap<String, TaskInputLayout>> {
[6752](#6752)    let mut task_mission_inputs: BTreeMap<String, Vec<(String, Vec<MissionTaskInput>)>> =
[6753](#6753)        BTreeMap::new();
[6754](#6754)
[6755](#6755)    for (mission_name, graph) in all_missions {
[6756](#6756)        for (node_id, node) in graph.get_all_nodes() {
[6757](#6757)            if node.get_flavor() != Flavor::Task {
[6758](#6758)                continue;
[6759](#6759)            }
[6760](#6760)
[6761](#6761)            if find_task_type_for_id(graph, node_id)? == CuTaskType::Source {
[6762](#6762)                continue;
[6763](#6763)            }
[6764](#6764)
[6765](#6765)            let task_id = node.get_id().to_string();
[6766](#6766)            let mission_inputs = collect_mission_task_inputs(graph, node_id, task_id.as_str())?;
[6767](#6767)            task_mission_inputs
[6768](#6768)                .entry(task_id)
[6769](#6769)                .or_default()
[6770](#6770)                .push((mission_name.clone(), mission_inputs));
[6771](#6771)        }
[6772](#6772)    }
[6773](#6773)
[6774](#6774)    let mut layouts = HashMap::new();
[6775](#6775)    for (task_id, mission_inputs) in task_mission_inputs {
[6776](#6776)        let mut mission_iter = mission_inputs.into_iter();
[6777](#6777)        let Some((first_mission, first_inputs)) = mission_iter.next() else {
[6778](#6778)            continue;
[6779](#6779)        };
[6780](#6780)
[6781](#6781)        let slots: Vec<CanonicalTaskInputSlot> = first_inputs
[6782](#6782)            .iter()
[6783](#6783)            .map(|input| CanonicalTaskInputSlot {
[6784](#6784)                msg_type: input.msg_type.clone(),
[6785](#6785)                connection_orders: BTreeSet::from([input.connection_order]),
[6786](#6786)            })
[6787](#6787)            .collect();
[6788](#6788)        let mut mission_slot_mappings = HashMap::new();
[6789](#6789)        mission_slot_mappings.insert(
[6790](#6790)            first_mission,
[6791](#6791)            (0..first_inputs.len()).map(Some).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
[6792](#6792)        );
[6793](#6793)
[6794](#6794)        let mut layout = TaskInputLayout {
[6795](#6795)            slots,
[6796](#6796)            mission_slot_mappings,
[6797](#6797)        };
[6798](#6798)        for (mission_name, mission_inputs) in mission_iter {
[6799](#6799)            merge_task_input_layout(&task_id, &mut layout, mission_name, mission_inputs)?;
[6800](#6800)        }
[6801](#6801)
[6802](#6802)        layouts.insert(task_id, layout);
[6803](#6803)    }
[6804](#6804)
[6805](#6805)    Ok(layouts)

[6813](#6813)fn present_task_input_expr(
[6814](#6814)    input: &cu29_runtime::curuntime::CuInputMsg,
[6815](#6815)    output_pack_sizes: &[usize],
[6816](#6816)) -> proc_macro2::TokenStream {
[6817](#6817)    let input_index = int2sliceindex(input.culist_index);
[6818](#6818)    let output_size = output_pack_sizes
[6819](#6819)        .get(input.culist_index as usize)
[6820](#6820)        .copied()
[6821](#6821)        .unwrap_or_else(|| {

[6824](#6824)                input.culist_index

[6826](#6826)        });
[6827](#6827)    if output_size > 1 {
[6828](#6828)        let port_index = syn::Index::from(input.src_port);
[6829](#6829)        quote! { &msgs.#input_index.#port_index }

[6835](#6835)fn generate_task_input_binding(
[6836](#6836)    step: &CuExecutionStep,
[6837](#6837)    mission_name: &str,
[6838](#6838)    output_pack_sizes: &[usize],
[6839](#6839)    task_input_layouts: &HashMap<String, TaskInputLayout>,
[6840](#6840)) -> GeneratedTaskInput {
[6841](#6841)    let task_id = step.node.get_id().to_string();
[6842](#6842)    let layout = task_input_layouts
[6843](#6843)        .get(&task_id)
[6844](#6844)        .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Missing canonical input layout for task '{task_id}'"));
[6845](#6845)    let slot_mapping = layout
[6846](#6846)        .mission_slot_mappings
[6847](#6847)        .get(mission_name)
[6848](#6848)        .unwrap_or_else(|| {
[6849](#6849)            panic!("Missing input slot mapping for task '{task_id}' in mission '{mission_name}'")
[6850](#6850)        });
[6851](#6851)
[6852](#6852)    let mut setup = Vec::new();
[6853](#6853)    let mut refs = Vec::new();
[6854](#6854)
[6855](#6855)    for (slot_index, slot) in layout.slots.iter().enumerate() {
[6856](#6856)        if let Some(input_index) = slot_mapping.get(slot_index).copied().flatten() {
[6857](#6857)            let input = step.input_msg_indices_types.get(input_index).unwrap_or_else(|| {
[6858](#6858)                panic!(
[6859](#6859)                    "Task '{task_id}' mission '{mission_name}' input slot {slot_index} mapped to missing input index {input_index}"
[6860](#6860)                )
[6861](#6861)            });
[6862](#6862)            refs.push(present_task_input_expr(input, output_pack_sizes));
[6863](#6863)            continue;
[6864](#6864)        }
[6865](#6865)
[6866](#6866)        let empty_input_ident = format_ident!("__cu_missing_input_{slot_index}");
[6867](#6867)        let input_ty: Type = parse_str(slot.msg_type.as_str()).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
[6868](#6868)            panic!(
[6869](#6869)                "Could not parse canonical input message type '{}' for task '{}': {err}",
[6870](#6870)                slot.msg_type, task_id
[6871](#6871)            )
[6872](#6872)        });
[6873](#6873)        setup.push(quote! {
[6874](#6874)            let #empty_input_ident = cu29::cutask::CuMsg::<#input_ty>::new(None);
[6875](#6875)        });
[6876](#6876)        refs.push(quote! { &#empty_input_ident });
[6877](#6877)    }
[6878](#6878)
[6879](#6879)    let expr = match refs.len() {
[6880](#6880)        0 => quote! { &() },
[6881](#6881)        1 => refs
[6882](#6882)            .into_iter()
[6883](#6883)            .next()
[6884](#6884)            .expect("single input expression missing"),
[6885](#6885)        _ => quote! { &( #(#refs),* ) },
[6886](#6886)    };
[6887](#6887)
[6888](#6888)    GeneratedTaskInput {
[6889](#6889)        setup: quote! { #(#setup)* },
[6890](#6890)        expr,
[6891](#6891)    }

[7006](#7006)                #normal_encode

[7160](#7160)fn collect_bridge_channel_usage(graph: &CuGraph) -> HashMap<BridgeChannelKey, String> {
[7161](#7161)    let mut usage = HashMap::new();
[7162](#7162)    for cnx in graph.edges() {
[7163](#7163)        if let Some(channel) = &cnx.src_channel {
[7164](#7164)            let key = BridgeChannelKey {
[7165](#7165)                bridge_id: cnx.src.clone(),
[7166](#7166)                channel_id: channel.clone(),
[7167](#7167)                direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Rx,
[7168](#7168)            };
[7169](#7169)            usage
[7170](#7170)                .entry(key)
[7171](#7171)                .and_modify(|msg| {
[7172](#7172)                    if msg != &cnx.msg {
[7173](#7173)                        panic!(
[7174](#7174)                            "Bridge '{}' channel '{}' is used with incompatible message types: {} vs {}",
[7175](#7175)                            cnx.src, channel, msg, cnx.msg
[7176](#7176)                        );
[7177](#7177)                    }
[7178](#7178)                })
[7179](#7179)                .or_insert(cnx.msg.clone());
[7180](#7180)        }
[7181](#7181)        if let Some(channel) = &cnx.dst_channel {
[7182](#7182)            let key = BridgeChannelKey {
[7183](#7183)                bridge_id: cnx.dst.clone(),
[7184](#7184)                channel_id: channel.clone(),
[7185](#7185)                direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Tx,
[7186](#7186)            };
[7187](#7187)            usage
[7188](#7188)                .entry(key)
[7189](#7189)                .and_modify(|msg| {
[7190](#7190)                    if msg != &cnx.msg {
[7191](#7191)                        panic!(
[7192](#7192)                            "Bridge '{}' channel '{}' is used with incompatible message types: {} vs {}",
[7193](#7193)                            cnx.dst, channel, msg, cnx.msg
[7194](#7194)                        );
[7195](#7195)                    }
[7196](#7196)                })
[7197](#7197)                .or_insert(cnx.msg.clone());
[7198](#7198)        }
[7199](#7199)    }
[7200](#7200)    usage

[7206](#7206)    channel_usage: &HashMap<BridgeChannelKey, String>,

[7217](#7217)                bridge_cfg.type_, bridge_cfg.id
[7218](#7218)            )

[7221](#7221)        let mut rx_channels = Vec::new();

[7223](#7223)

[7225](#7225)            match channel {

[7229](#7229)                        channel_id: id.clone(),
[7230](#7230)                        direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Rx,
[7231](#7231)                    };

[7235](#7235)                            panic!(
[7236](#7236)                                "Could not parse message type '{msg_type}' for bridge '{}' channel '{}': {err}",
[7237](#7237)                                bridge_cfg.id, id

[7338](#7338)fn parse_resource_path(path: &str) -> CuResult<(String, String)> {
[7339](#7339)    let (bundle_id, name) = path.split_once('.').ok_or_else(|| {
[7340](#7340)        CuError::from(format!(
[7341](#7341)            "Resource '{path}' is missing a bundle prefix (expected bundle.resource)"
[7342](#7342)        ))
[7343](#7343)    })?;
[7344](#7344)
[7345](#7345)    if bundle_id.is_empty() || name.is_empty() {
[7346](#7346)        return Err(CuError::from(format!(
[7347](#7347)            "Resource '{path}' must use the 'bundle.resource' format"
[7348](#7348)        )));
[7349](#7349)    }
[7350](#7350)
[7351](#7351)    Ok((bundle_id.to_string(), name.to_string()))

[7354](#7354)fn collect_resource_specs(
[7355](#7355)    graph: &CuGraph,
[7356](#7356)    task_specs: &CuTaskSpecSet,
[7357](#7357)    bridge_specs: &[BridgeSpec],
[7358](#7358)    bundle_specs: &[BundleSpec],
[7359](#7359)) -> CuResult<Vec<ResourceKeySpec>> {
[7360](#7360)    let mut bridge_lookup: BTreeMap<String, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
[7361](#7361)    for (idx, spec) in bridge_specs.iter().enumerate() {
[7362](#7362)        bridge_lookup.insert(spec.id.clone(), idx);
[7363](#7363)    }
[7364](#7364)
[7365](#7365)    let mut bundle_lookup: HashMap<String, (usize, syn::Path)> = HashMap::new();
[7366](#7366)    for (index, bundle) in bundle_specs.iter().enumerate() {
[7367](#7367)        bundle_lookup.insert(bundle.id.clone(), (index, bundle.provider_path.clone()));
[7368](#7368)    }
[7369](#7369)
[7370](#7370)    let mut specs = Vec::new();
[7371](#7371)
[7372](#7372)    for (node_id, node) in graph.get_all_nodes() {
[7373](#7373)        let resources = node.get_resources();
[7374](#7374)        if let Some(resources) = resources {
[7375](#7375)            let task_index = task_specs.node_id_to_task_index[node_id as usize];
[7376](#7376)            let owner = if let Some(task_index) = task_index {
[7377](#7377)                ResourceOwner::Task(task_index)
[7378](#7378)            } else if node.get_flavor() == Flavor::Bridge {
[7379](#7379)                let bridge_index = bridge_lookup.get(&node.get_id()).ok_or_else(|| {
[7380](#7380)                    CuError::from(format!(
[7381](#7381)                        "Resource mapping attached to unknown bridge node '{}'",
[7382](#7382)                        node.get_id()
[7383](#7383)                    ))
[7384](#7384)                })?;
[7385](#7385)                ResourceOwner::Bridge(*bridge_index)
[7386](#7386)            } else {
[7387](#7387)                return Err(CuError::from(format!(
[7388](#7388)                    "Resource mapping attached to non-task node '{}'",
[7389](#7389)                    node.get_id()
[7390](#7390)                )));
[7391](#7391)            };
[7392](#7392)
[7393](#7393)            for (binding_name, path) in resources {
[7394](#7394)                let (bundle_id, resource_name) = parse_resource_path(path)?;
[7395](#7395)                let (bundle_index, provider_path) =
[7396](#7396)                    bundle_lookup.get(&bundle_id).ok_or_else(|| {
[7397](#7397)                        CuError::from(format!(
[7398](#7398)                            "Resource '{}' references unknown bundle '{}'",
[7399](#7399)                            path, bundle_id
[7400](#7400)                        ))
[7401](#7401)                    })?;
[7402](#7402)                specs.push(ResourceKeySpec {
[7403](#7403)                    bundle_index: *bundle_index,
[7404](#7404)                    provider_path: provider_path.clone(),
[7405](#7405)                    resource_name,
[7406](#7406)                    binding_name: binding_name.clone(),
[7407](#7407)                    owner,
[7408](#7408)                });
[7409](#7409)            }
[7410](#7410)        }
[7411](#7411)    }
[7412](#7412)
[7413](#7413)    Ok(specs)
[7414](#7414)}

[7453](#7453)fn build_resources_module(
[7454](#7454)    bundle_specs: &[BundleSpec],
[7455](#7455)) -> CuResult<(proc_macro2::TokenStream, proc_macro2::TokenStream)> {
[7456](#7456)    let bundle_consts = bundle_specs.iter().enumerate().map(|(index, bundle)| {
[7457](#7457)        let const_ident = Ident::new(
[7458](#7458)            &config_id_to_bridge_const(bundle.id.as_str()),
[7459](#7459)            Span::call_site(),
[7460](#7460)        );
[7461](#7461)        quote! { pub const #const_ident: BundleIndex = BundleIndex::new(#index); }
[7462](#7462)    });
[7463](#7463)
[7464](#7464)    let resources_module = quote! {
[7465](#7465)        pub mod resources {
[7466](#7466)            #![allow(dead_code)]
[7467](#7467)            use cu29::resource::BundleIndex;
[7468](#7468)
[7469](#7469)            pub mod bundles {
[7470](#7470)                use super::BundleIndex;
[7471](#7471)                #(#bundle_consts)*
[7472](#7472)            }
[7473](#7473)        }
[7474](#7474)    };
[7475](#7475)
[7476](#7476)    let bundle_counts = bundle_specs.iter().map(|bundle| {
[7477](#7477)        let provider_path = &bundle.provider_path;
[7478](#7478)        quote! { <#provider_path as cu29::resource::ResourceBundleDecl>::Id::COUNT }
[7479](#7479)    });
[7480](#7480)
[7481](#7481)    let bundle_inits = bundle_specs
[7482](#7482)        .iter()
[7483](#7483)        .enumerate()
[7484](#7484)        .map(|(index, bundle)| {
[7485](#7485)            let bundle_id = LitStr::new(bundle.id.as_str(), Span::call_site());
[7486](#7486)            let provider_path = &bundle.provider_path;
[7487](#7487)            quote! {
[7488](#7488)                let bundle_cfg = config
[7489](#7489)                    .resources
[7490](#7490)                    .iter()
[7491](#7491)                    .find(|b| b.id == #bundle_id)
[7492](#7492)                    .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Resource bundle '{}' missing from configuration", #bundle_id));
[7493](#7493)                let bundle_ctx = cu29::resource::BundleContext::<#provider_path>::new(
[7494](#7494)                    cu29::resource::BundleIndex::new(#index),
[7495](#7495)                    #bundle_id,
[7496](#7496)                );
[7497](#7497)                <#provider_path as cu29::resource::ResourceBundle>::build(
[7498](#7498)                    bundle_ctx,
[7499](#7499)                    bundle_cfg.config.as_ref(),
[7500](#7500)                    &mut manager,
[7501](#7501)                )?;
[7502](#7502)            }
[7503](#7503)            })
[7504](#7504)            .collect::<Vec<_>>();
[7505](#7505)
[7506](#7506)    let resources_instanciator = quote! {
[7507](#7507)        pub fn resources_instanciator(config: &CuConfig) -> CuResult<cu29::resource::ResourceManager> {
[7508](#7508)            let bundle_counts: &[usize] = &[ #(#bundle_counts),* ];
[7509](#7509)            let mut manager = cu29::resource::ResourceManager::new(bundle_counts);
[7510](#7510)            #(#bundle_inits)*
[7511](#7511)            Ok(manager)
[7512](#7512)        }
[7513](#7513)    };
[7514](#7514)
[7515](#7515)    Ok((resources_module, resources_instanciator))

[7518](#7518)struct ResourceMappingTokens {

[7520](#7520)    refs: Vec<proc_macro2::TokenStream>,
[7521](#7521)}
[7522](#7522)
[7523](#7523)fn build_task_resource_mappings(
[7524](#7524)    resource_specs: &[ResourceKeySpec],
[7525](#7525)    task_specs: &CuTaskSpecSet,
[7526](#7526)    sim_mode: bool,
[7527](#7527)) -> CuResult<ResourceMappingTokens> {
[7528](#7528)    let mut per_task: Vec<Vec<&ResourceKeySpec>> = vec![Vec::new(); task_specs.ids.len()];
[7529](#7529)
[7530](#7530)    for spec in resource_specs {
[7531](#7531)        let ResourceOwner::Task(task_index) = spec.owner else {
[7532](#7532)            continue;
[7533](#7533)        };
[7534](#7534)        if sim_mode
[7535](#7535)            && !task_specs.run_in_sim_flags[task_index]
[7536](#7536)            && task_specs.cutypes[task_index] != CuTaskType::Regular
[7537](#7537)        {
[7538](#7538)            continue;
[7539](#7539)        }
[7540](#7540)        per_task
[7541](#7541)            .get_mut(task_index)
[7542](#7542)            .ok_or_else(|| {
[7543](#7543)                CuError::from(format!(
[7544](#7544)                    "Resource '{}' mapped to invalid task index {}",
[7545](#7545)                    spec.binding_name, task_index
[7546](#7546)                ))
[7547](#7547)            })?
[7548](#7548)            .push(spec);
[7549](#7549)    }
[7550](#7550)
[7551](#7551)    let mut mapping_defs = Vec::new();
[7552](#7552)    let mut mapping_refs = Vec::new();
[7553](#7553)
[7554](#7554)    for (idx, entries) in per_task.iter().enumerate() {
[7555](#7555)        if entries.is_empty() {
[7556](#7556)            mapping_refs.push(quote! { None });
[7557](#7557)            continue;
[7558](#7558)        }
[7559](#7559)
[7560](#7560)        let binding_task_type = if task_specs.background_flags[idx] {
[7561](#7561)            &task_specs.sim_task_types[idx]
[7562](#7562)        } else {
[7563](#7563)            &task_specs.task_types[idx]
[7564](#7564)        };
[7565](#7565)
[7566](#7566)        let binding_trait = match task_specs.cutypes[idx] {
[7567](#7567)            CuTaskType::Source => quote! { CuSrcTask },
[7568](#7568)            CuTaskType::Regular => quote! { CuTask },
[7569](#7569)            CuTaskType::Sink => quote! { CuSinkTask },
[7570](#7570)        };
[7571](#7571)
[7572](#7572)        let entries_ident = format_ident!("TASK{}_RES_ENTRIES", idx);
[7573](#7573)        let map_ident = format_ident!("TASK{}_RES_MAPPING", idx);
[7574](#7574)        let binding_type = quote! {
[7575](#7575)            <<#binding_task_type as #binding_trait>::Resources<'_> as ResourceBindings>::Binding
[7576](#7576)        };
[7577](#7577)        let entry_tokens = entries.iter().map(|spec| {
[7578](#7578)            let binding_ident = Ident::new(
[7579](#7579)                &config_id_to_enum(spec.binding_name.as_str()),
[7580](#7580)                Span::call_site(),
[7581](#7581)            );
[7582](#7582)            let resource_name = LitStr::new(spec.resource_name.as_str(), Span::call_site());
[7583](#7583)            let bundle_index = spec.bundle_index;
[7584](#7584)            let provider_path = &spec.provider_path;
[7585](#7585)            quote! {
[7586](#7586)                (#binding_type::#binding_ident, cu29::resource::ResourceKey::new(
[7587](#7587)                    cu29::resource::BundleIndex::new(#bundle_index),
[7588](#7588)                    cu29::resource::resource_index_by_name::<#provider_path>(#resource_name),
[7589](#7589)                ))
[7590](#7590)            }
[7591](#7591)        });
[7592](#7592)
[7593](#7593)        mapping_defs.push(quote! {
[7594](#7594)            const #entries_ident: &[(#binding_type, cu29::resource::ResourceKey)] = &[ #(#entry_tokens),* ];
[7595](#7595)            const #map_ident: cu29::resource::ResourceBindingMap<#binding_type> =
[7596](#7596)                cu29::resource::ResourceBindingMap::new(#entries_ident);
[7597](#7597)        });
[7598](#7598)        mapping_refs.push(quote! { Some(&#map_ident) });
[7599](#7599)    }
[7600](#7600)
[7601](#7601)    Ok(ResourceMappingTokens {
[7602](#7602)        defs: quote! { #(#mapping_defs)* },
[7603](#7603)        refs: mapping_refs,
[7604](#7604)    })
[7605](#7605)}
[7606](#7606)
[7607](#7607)fn build_bridge_resource_mappings(
[7608](#7608)    resource_specs: &[ResourceKeySpec],
[7609](#7609)    bridge_specs: &[BridgeSpec],
[7610](#7610)    sim_mode: bool,
[7611](#7611)) -> ResourceMappingTokens {
[7612](#7612)    let mut per_bridge: Vec<Vec<&ResourceKeySpec>> = vec![Vec::new(); bridge_specs.len()];
[7613](#7613)
[7614](#7614)    for spec in resource_specs {
[7615](#7615)        let ResourceOwner::Bridge(bridge_index) = spec.owner else {
[7616](#7616)            continue;
[7617](#7617)        };
[7618](#7618)        if sim_mode && !bridge_specs[bridge_index].run_in_sim {
[7619](#7619)            continue;

[7621](#7621)        per_bridge[bridge_index].push(spec);
[7622](#7622)    }
[7623](#7623)
[7624](#7624)    let mut mapping_defs = Vec::new();
[7625](#7625)    let mut mapping_refs = Vec::new();
[7626](#7626)
[7627](#7627)    for (idx, entries) in per_bridge.iter().enumerate() {
[7628](#7628)        if entries.is_empty() {
[7629](#7629)            mapping_refs.push(quote! { None });
[7630](#7630)            continue;
[7631](#7631)        }
[7632](#7632)
[7633](#7633)        let bridge_type = &bridge_specs[idx].type_path;
[7634](#7634)        let binding_type = quote! {
[7635](#7635)            <<#bridge_type as cu29::cubridge::CuBridge>::Resources<'_> as ResourceBindings>::Binding
[7636](#7636)        };
[7637](#7637)        let entries_ident = format_ident!("BRIDGE{}_RES_ENTRIES", idx);
[7638](#7638)        let map_ident = format_ident!("BRIDGE{}_RES_MAPPING", idx);
[7639](#7639)        let entry_tokens = entries.iter().map(|spec| {
[7640](#7640)            let binding_ident = Ident::new(
[7641](#7641)                &config_id_to_enum(spec.binding_name.as_str()),
[7642](#7642)                Span::call_site(),
[7643](#7643)            );
[7644](#7644)            let resource_name = LitStr::new(spec.resource_name.as_str(), Span::call_site());
[7645](#7645)            let bundle_index = spec.bundle_index;
[7646](#7646)            let provider_path = &spec.provider_path;
[7647](#7647)            quote! {
[7648](#7648)                (#binding_type::#binding_ident, cu29::resource::ResourceKey::new(
[7649](#7649)                    cu29::resource::BundleIndex::new(#bundle_index),
[7650](#7650)                    cu29::resource::resource_index_by_name::<#provider_path>(#resource_name),
[7651](#7651)                ))
[7652](#7652)            }
[7653](#7653)        });
[7654](#7654)
[7655](#7655)        mapping_defs.push(quote! {
[7656](#7656)            const #entries_ident: &[(#binding_type, cu29::resource::ResourceKey)] = &[ #(#entry_tokens),* ];
[7657](#7657)            const #map_ident: cu29::resource::ResourceBindingMap<#binding_type> =
[7658](#7658)                cu29::resource::ResourceBindingMap::new(#entries_ident);
[7659](#7659)        });
[7660](#7660)        mapping_refs.push(quote! { Some(&#map_ident) });
[7661](#7661)    }
[7662](#7662)
[7663](#7663)    ResourceMappingTokens {
[7664](#7664)        defs: quote! { #(#mapping_defs)* },
[7665](#7665)        refs: mapping_refs,
[7666](#7666)    }
[7667](#7667)}
[7668](#7668)
[7669](#7669)fn build_execution_plan(
[7670](#7670)    graph: &CuGraph,
[7671](#7671)    task_specs: &CuTaskSpecSet,
[7672](#7672)    bridge_specs: &mut [BridgeSpec],
[7673](#7673)) -> CuResult<(
[7674](#7674)    CuExecutionLoop,
[7675](#7675)    Vec<ExecutionEntity>,
[7676](#7676)    HashMap<NodeId, NodeId>,
[7677](#7677))> {
[7678](#7678)    let mut plan_graph = CuGraph::default();
[7679](#7679)    let mut exec_entities = Vec::new();
[7680](#7680)    let mut original_to_plan = HashMap::new();
[7681](#7681)    let mut plan_to_original = HashMap::new();
[7682](#7682)    let mut name_to_original = HashMap::new();
[7683](#7683)    let mut channel_nodes = HashMap::new();
[7684](#7684)
[7685](#7685)    for (node_id, node) in graph.get_all_nodes() {
[7686](#7686)        name_to_original.insert(node.get_id(), node_id);
[7687](#7687)        if node.get_flavor() != Flavor::Task {
[7688](#7688)            continue;
[7689](#7689)        }
[7690](#7690)        let plan_node_id = plan_graph.add_node(node.clone())?;
[7691](#7691)        let task_index = task_specs.node_id_to_task_index[node_id as usize]
[7692](#7692)            .expect("Task missing from specifications");
[7693](#7693)        plan_to_original.insert(plan_node_id, node_id);
[7694](#7694)        original_to_plan.insert(node_id, plan_node_id);
[7695](#7695)        if plan_node_id as usize != exec_entities.len() {
[7696](#7696)            panic!("Unexpected node ordering while mirroring tasks in plan graph");
[7697](#7697)        }
[7698](#7698)        exec_entities.push(ExecutionEntity {
[7699](#7699)            kind: ExecutionEntityKind::Task { task_index },
[7700](#7700)        });
[7701](#7701)    }
[7702](#7702)
[7703](#7703)    for (node_id, node) in graph.get_all_nodes() {
[7704](#7704)        if node.get_flavor() != Flavor::Task {
[7705](#7705)            continue;
[7706](#7706)        }
[7707](#7707)        let Some(task_index) = task_specs.node_id_to_task_index[node_id as usize] else {
[7708](#7708)            continue;
[7709](#7709)        };
[7710](#7710)        if !task_specs
[7711](#7711)            .autogenerated_output_flags
[7712](#7712)            .get(task_index)
[7713](#7713)            .copied()
[7714](#7714)            .unwrap_or(false)
[7715](#7715)        {
[7716](#7716)            continue;
[7717](#7717)        }
[7718](#7718)        let plan_node_id = *original_to_plan
[7719](#7719)            .get(&node_id)
[7720](#7720)            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Task '{}' missing from mirrored plan graph", node.get_id()));
[7721](#7721)        let task_kind = task_specs.cutypes[task_index];
[7722](#7722)        let task_type: Type =
[7723](#7723)            parse_str(task_specs.type_names[task_index].as_str()).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
[7724](#7724)                panic!(
[7725](#7725)                    "Could not parse task type '{}': {err}",
[7726](#7726)                    task_specs.type_names[task_index]
[7727](#7727)                )
[7728](#7728)            });
[7729](#7729)        let msg_type = synthesized_single_output_msg_name(&task_type, task_kind);
[7730](#7730)        plan_graph
[7731](#7731)            .get_node_mut(plan_node_id)
[7732](#7732)            .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Plan node '{}' missing from mirrored graph", node.get_id()))
[7733](#7733)            .add_nc_output(msg_type.as_str(), usize::MAX);
[7734](#7734)    }
[7735](#7735)
[7736](#7736)    for (bridge_index, spec) in bridge_specs.iter_mut().enumerate() {
[7737](#7737)        for (channel_index, channel_spec) in spec.rx_channels.iter_mut().enumerate() {
[7738](#7738)            let mut node = Node::new(
[7739](#7739)                format!("{}::rx::{}", spec.id, channel_spec.id).as_str(),
[7740](#7740)                "__CuBridgeRxChannel",
[7741](#7741)            );
[7742](#7742)            node.set_flavor(Flavor::Bridge);
[7743](#7743)            let plan_node_id = plan_graph.add_node(node)?;
[7744](#7744)            if plan_node_id as usize != exec_entities.len() {
[7745](#7745)                panic!("Unexpected node ordering while inserting bridge rx channel");
[7746](#7746)            }
[7747](#7747)            channel_spec.plan_node_id = Some(plan_node_id);
[7748](#7748)            exec_entities.push(ExecutionEntity {
[7749](#7749)                kind: ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeRx {
[7750](#7750)                    bridge_index,
[7751](#7751)                    channel_index,
[7752](#7752)                },
[7753](#7753)            });
[7754](#7754)            channel_nodes.insert(
[7755](#7755)                BridgeChannelKey {
[7756](#7756)                    bridge_id: spec.id.clone(),
[7757](#7757)                    channel_id: channel_spec.id.clone(),
[7758](#7758)                    direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Rx,
[7759](#7759)                },
[7760](#7760)                plan_node_id,
[7761](#7761)            );
[7762](#7762)        }
[7763](#7763)
[7764](#7764)        for (channel_index, channel_spec) in spec.tx_channels.iter_mut().enumerate() {
[7765](#7765)            let mut node = Node::new(
[7766](#7766)                format!("{}::tx::{}", spec.id, channel_spec.id).as_str(),
[7767](#7767)                "__CuBridgeTxChannel",
[7768](#7768)            );
[7769](#7769)            node.set_flavor(Flavor::Bridge);
[7770](#7770)            let plan_node_id = plan_graph.add_node(node)?;
[7771](#7771)            if plan_node_id as usize != exec_entities.len() {
[7772](#7772)                panic!("Unexpected node ordering while inserting bridge tx channel");
[7773](#7773)            }
[7774](#7774)            channel_spec.plan_node_id = Some(plan_node_id);
[7775](#7775)            exec_entities.push(ExecutionEntity {
[7776](#7776)                kind: ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeTx {
[7777](#7777)                    bridge_index,
[7778](#7778)                    channel_index,
[7779](#7779)                },
[7780](#7780)            });
[7781](#7781)            channel_nodes.insert(
[7782](#7782)                BridgeChannelKey {
[7783](#7783)                    bridge_id: spec.id.clone(),
[7784](#7784)                    channel_id: channel_spec.id.clone(),
[7785](#7785)                    direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Tx,
[7786](#7786)                },
[7787](#7787)                plan_node_id,
[7788](#7788)            );
[7789](#7789)        }
[7790](#7790)    }
[7791](#7791)
[7792](#7792)    for cnx in graph.edges() {
[7793](#7793)        let src_plan = if let Some(channel) = &cnx.src_channel {
[7794](#7794)            let key = BridgeChannelKey {
[7795](#7795)                bridge_id: cnx.src.clone(),
[7796](#7796)                channel_id: channel.clone(),
[7797](#7797)                direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Rx,
[7798](#7798)            };
[7799](#7799)            *channel_nodes
[7800](#7800)                .get(&key)
[7801](#7801)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Bridge source {:?} missing from plan graph", key))
[7802](#7802)        } else {
[7803](#7803)            let node_id = name_to_original
[7804](#7804)                .get(&cnx.src)
[7805](#7805)                .copied()
[7806](#7806)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Unknown source node '{}'", cnx.src));
[7807](#7807)            *original_to_plan
[7808](#7808)                .get(&node_id)
[7809](#7809)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Source node '{}' missing from plan", cnx.src))
[7810](#7810)        };
[7811](#7811)
[7812](#7812)        let dst_plan = if let Some(channel) = &cnx.dst_channel {
[7813](#7813)            let key = BridgeChannelKey {
[7814](#7814)                bridge_id: cnx.dst.clone(),
[7815](#7815)                channel_id: channel.clone(),
[7816](#7816)                direction: BridgeChannelDirection::Tx,
[7817](#7817)            };
[7818](#7818)            *channel_nodes
[7819](#7819)                .get(&key)
[7820](#7820)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Bridge destination {:?} missing from plan graph", key))
[7821](#7821)        } else {
[7822](#7822)            let node_id = name_to_original
[7823](#7823)                .get(&cnx.dst)
[7824](#7824)                .copied()
[7825](#7825)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Unknown destination node '{}'", cnx.dst));
[7826](#7826)            *original_to_plan
[7827](#7827)                .get(&node_id)
[7828](#7828)                .unwrap_or_else(|| panic!("Destination node '{}' missing from plan", cnx.dst))
[7829](#7829)        };
[7830](#7830)
[7831](#7831)        plan_graph
[7832](#7832)            .connect_ext_with_order(
[7833](#7833)                src_plan,
[7834](#7834)                dst_plan,
[7835](#7835)                &cnx.msg,
[7836](#7836)                cnx.missions.clone(),
[7837](#7837)                None,
[7838](#7838)                None,
[7839](#7839)                cnx.order,
[7840](#7840)            )
[7841](#7841)            .map_err(|e| CuError::from(e.to_string()))?;
[7842](#7842)    }
[7843](#7843)
[7844](#7844)    let runtime_plan = compute_runtime_plan(&plan_graph)?;
[7845](#7845)    Ok((runtime_plan, exec_entities, plan_to_original))
[7846](#7846)}

[7848](#7848)fn collect_culist_metadata(
[7849](#7849)    runtime_plan: &CuExecutionLoop,
[7850](#7850)    exec_entities: &[ExecutionEntity],
[7851](#7851)    bridge_specs: &mut [BridgeSpec],
[7852](#7852)    plan_to_original: &HashMap<NodeId, NodeId>,
[7853](#7853)) -> (Vec<usize>, HashMap<NodeId, usize>) {
[7854](#7854)    let mut culist_order = Vec::new();
[7855](#7855)    let mut node_output_positions = HashMap::new();
[7856](#7856)
[7857](#7857)    for unit in &runtime_plan.steps {
[7858](#7858)        if let CuExecutionUnit::Step(step) = unit
[7859](#7859)            && let Some(output_pack) = &step.output_msg_pack
[7860](#7860)        {
[7861](#7861)            let output_idx = output_pack.culist_index;
[7862](#7862)            culist_order.push(output_idx as usize);
[7863](#7863)            match &exec_entities[step.node_id as usize].kind {
[7864](#7864)                ExecutionEntityKind::Task { .. } => {
[7865](#7865)                    if let Some(original_node_id) = plan_to_original.get(&step.node_id) {
[7866](#7866)                        node_output_positions.insert(*original_node_id, output_idx as usize);
[7867](#7867)                    }
[7868](#7868)                }
[7869](#7869)                ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeRx {
[7870](#7870)                    bridge_index,
[7871](#7871)                    channel_index,
[7872](#7872)                } => {
[7873](#7873)                    bridge_specs[*bridge_index].rx_channels[*channel_index].culist_index =
[7874](#7874)                        Some(output_idx as usize);
[7875](#7875)                }
[7876](#7876)                ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeTx {
[7877](#7877)                    bridge_index,
[7878](#7878)                    channel_index,
[7879](#7879)                } => {
[7880](#7880)                    bridge_specs[*bridge_index].tx_channels[*channel_index].culist_index =
[7881](#7881)                        Some(output_idx as usize);
[7882](#7882)                }
[7883](#7883)            }
[7884](#7884)        }
[7885](#7885)    }
[7886](#7886)
[7887](#7887)    (culist_order, node_output_positions)
[7888](#7888)}

[7890](#7890)fn build_monitor_culist_component_mapping(
[7891](#7891)    runtime_plan: &CuExecutionLoop,
[7892](#7892)    exec_entities: &[ExecutionEntity],
[7893](#7893)    bridge_specs: &[BridgeSpec],
[7894](#7894)) -> Result<Vec<usize>, String> {
[7895](#7895)    let mut mapping = Vec::new();
[7896](#7896)    for unit in &runtime_plan.steps {
[7897](#7897)        if let CuExecutionUnit::Step(step) = unit
[7898](#7898)            && step.output_msg_pack.is_some()
[7899](#7899)        {
[7900](#7900)            let Some(entity) = exec_entities.get(step.node_id as usize) else {
[7901](#7901)                return Err(format!(
[7902](#7902)                    "Missing execution entity for plan node {} while building monitor mapping",
[7903](#7903)                    step.node_id
[7904](#7904)                ));
[7905](#7905)            };
[7906](#7906)            let component_index = match &entity.kind {
[7907](#7907)                ExecutionEntityKind::Task { task_index } => *task_index,
[7908](#7908)                ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeRx {
[7909](#7909)                    bridge_index,
[7910](#7910)                    channel_index,
[7911](#7911)                } => bridge_specs
[7912](#7912)                    .get(*bridge_index)
[7913](#7913)                    .and_then(|spec| spec.rx_channels.get(*channel_index))
[7914](#7914)                    .and_then(|channel| channel.monitor_index)
[7915](#7915)                    .ok_or_else(|| {
[7916](#7916)                        format!(
[7917](#7917)                            "Missing monitor index for bridge rx {}:{}",
[7918](#7918)                            bridge_index, channel_index
[7919](#7919)                        )
[7920](#7920)                    })?,
[7921](#7921)                ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeTx {
[7922](#7922)                    bridge_index,
[7923](#7923)                    channel_index,
[7924](#7924)                } => bridge_specs
[7925](#7925)                    .get(*bridge_index)
[7926](#7926)                    .and_then(|spec| spec.tx_channels.get(*channel_index))
[7927](#7927)                    .and_then(|channel| channel.monitor_index)
[7928](#7928)                    .ok_or_else(|| {
[7929](#7929)                        format!(
[7930](#7930)                            "Missing monitor index for bridge tx {}:{}",
[7931](#7931)                            bridge_index, channel_index
[7932](#7932)                        )
[7933](#7933)                    })?,
[7934](#7934)            };
[7935](#7935)            mapping.push(component_index);
[7936](#7936)        }
[7937](#7937)    }
[7938](#7938)    Ok(mapping)

[7941](#7941)fn build_parallel_rt_stage_entries(
[7942](#7942)    runtime_plan: &CuExecutionLoop,
[7943](#7943)    exec_entities: &[ExecutionEntity],
[7944](#7944)    task_specs: &CuTaskSpecSet,
[7945](#7945)    bridge_specs: &[BridgeSpec],
[7946](#7946)) -> CuResult<Vec<proc_macro2::TokenStream>> {
[7947](#7947)    let mut entries = Vec::new();
[7948](#7948)
[7949](#7949)    for unit in &runtime_plan.steps {
[7950](#7950)        let CuExecutionUnit::Step(step) = unit else {
[7951](#7951)            todo!("parallel runtime metadata for nested loops is not implemented yet")
[7952](#7952)        };
[7953](#7953)
[7954](#7954)        let entity = exec_entities.get(step.node_id as usize).ok_or_else(|| {
[7955](#7955)            CuError::from(format!(
[7956](#7956)                "Missing execution entity for runtime plan node {} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[7957](#7957)                step.node_id
[7958](#7958)            ))
[7959](#7959)        })?;
[7960](#7960)
[7961](#7961)        let (label, kind_tokens, component_index) = match &entity.kind {
[7962](#7962)            ExecutionEntityKind::Task { task_index } => (
[7963](#7963)                task_specs
[7964](#7964)                    .ids
[7965](#7965)                    .get(*task_index)
[7966](#7966)                    .cloned()
[7967](#7967)                    .ok_or_else(|| {
[7968](#7968)                        CuError::from(format!(
[7969](#7969)                            "Missing task id for task index {} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[7970](#7970)                            task_index
[7971](#7971)                        ))
[7972](#7972)                    })?,
[7973](#7973)                quote! { cu29::parallel_rt::ParallelRtStageKind::Task },
[7974](#7974)                *task_index,
[7975](#7975)            ),
[7976](#7976)            ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeRx {
[7977](#7977)                bridge_index,
[7978](#7978)                channel_index,
[7979](#7979)            } => {
[7980](#7980)                let bridge = bridge_specs.get(*bridge_index).ok_or_else(|| {
[7981](#7981)                    CuError::from(format!(
[7982](#7982)                        "Missing bridge spec {} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[7983](#7983)                        bridge_index
[7984](#7984)                    ))
[7985](#7985)                })?;
[7986](#7986)                let channel = bridge.rx_channels.get(*channel_index).ok_or_else(|| {
[7987](#7987)                    CuError::from(format!(
[7988](#7988)                        "Missing bridge rx channel {}:{} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[7989](#7989)                        bridge_index, channel_index
[7990](#7990)                    ))
[7991](#7991)                })?;
[7992](#7992)                let component_index = channel.monitor_index.ok_or_else(|| {
[7993](#7993)                    CuError::from(format!(
[7994](#7994)                        "Missing monitor index for bridge rx {}:{} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[7995](#7995)                        bridge_index, channel_index
[7996](#7996)                    ))
[7997](#7997)                })?;
[7998](#7998)                (
[7999](#7999)                    format!("bridge::{}::rx::{}", bridge.id, channel.id),
[8000](#8000)                    quote! { cu29::parallel_rt::ParallelRtStageKind::BridgeRx },
[8001](#8001)                    component_index,
[8002](#8002)                )
[8003](#8003)            }
[8004](#8004)            ExecutionEntityKind::BridgeTx {
[8005](#8005)                bridge_index,
[8006](#8006)                channel_index,
[8007](#8007)            } => {
[8008](#8008)                let bridge = bridge_specs.get(*bridge_index).ok_or_else(|| {
[8009](#8009)                    CuError::from(format!(
[8010](#8010)                        "Missing bridge spec {} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[8011](#8011)                        bridge_index
[8012](#8012)                    ))
[8013](#8013)                })?;
[8014](#8014)                let channel = bridge.tx_channels.get(*channel_index).ok_or_else(|| {
[8015](#8015)                    CuError::from(format!(
[8016](#8016)                        "Missing bridge tx channel {}:{} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[8017](#8017)                        bridge_index, channel_index
[8018](#8018)                    ))
[8019](#8019)                })?;
[8020](#8020)                let component_index = channel.monitor_index.ok_or_else(|| {
[8021](#8021)                    CuError::from(format!(
[8022](#8022)                        "Missing monitor index for bridge tx {}:{} while building parallel runtime metadata",
[8023](#8023)                        bridge_index, channel_index
[8024](#8024)                    ))
[8025](#8025)                })?;
[8026](#8026)                (
[8027](#8027)                    format!("bridge::{}::tx::{}", bridge.id, channel.id),
[8028](#8028)                    quote! { cu29::parallel_rt::ParallelRtStageKind::BridgeTx },
[8029](#8029)                    component_index,
[8030](#8030)                )
[8031](#8031)            }
[8032](#8032)        };
[8033](#8033)
[8034](#8034)        let node_id = step.node_id;
[8035](#8035)        entries.push(quote! {
[8036](#8036)            cu29::parallel_rt::ParallelRtStageMetadata::new(
[8037](#8037)                #label,
[8038](#8038)                #kind_tokens,
[8039](#8039)                #node_id,
[8040](#8040)                cu29::monitoring::ComponentId::new(#component_index),
[8041](#8041)            )

[8044](#8044)
[8045](#8045)    Ok(entries)

[8049](#8049)fn build_monitored_ids(task_ids: &[String], bridge_specs: &mut [BridgeSpec]) -> Vec<String> {

[8060](#8060)            names.push(format!("bridge::{}::tx::{}", spec.id, channel.id));

[8083](#8083)fn abort_process_step_tokens(wrap_process_step: bool) -> proc_macro2::TokenStream {
[8084](#8084)    if wrap_process_step {
[8085](#8085)        quote! {

[8087](#8087)        }
[8088](#8088)    } else {
[8089](#8089)        quote! {
[8090](#8090)            __cu_abort_copperlist = true;
[8091](#8091)            break '__cu_process_steps;

[8096](#8096)fn parallel_task_lifecycle_tokens(
[8097](#8097)    task_kind: CuTaskType,
[8098](#8098)    task_type: &Type,
[8099](#8099)    component_index: usize,
[8100](#8100)    mission_mod: &Ident,
[8101](#8101)    task_instance: &proc_macro2::TokenStream,
[8102](#8102)    placement: ParallelLifecyclePlacement,
[8103](#8103)) -> (proc_macro2::TokenStream, proc_macro2::TokenStream) {
[8104](#8104)    let rt_guard = rtsan_guard_tokens();
[8105](#8105)    let abort_process_step = abort_process_step_tokens(true);
